Name: Content Patcher - Beta-Inspired Haley
Author: Seyph
Description:
Changes to Haley's outfit inspired by her beta counterpart (light blue top and white skirt) and to match her photography event. Better swimsuit. Hair is a lighter yellow, and body is more symmetric.

Requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
